canvas.css: height: 100%; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; gap: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 55%, var(--background)); color: var(--foreground); letter-spacing: .01em; --user-bubble-bg: var(--muted); --user-bubble-text: var(--foreground); --chat-message-gap: 28px; --chat-transcript-block-padding: 24px; --chat-message-paragraph-gap: .8em;

children.css: flex: 1 1 0%; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent);

canvas.css: height: 100%; min-height: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 6px; gap: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 55%, var(--background)); color: var(--foreground); letter-spacing: .01em; --user-bubble-bg: var(--muted); --user-bubble-text: var(--foreground); --chat-message-gap: 28px; --chat-transcript-block-padding: 16px; --chat-message-paragraph-gap: .8em;

children.css: flex: 1 1 0%; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent);
